summary: The Lakers dossiers were mostly accurate on current facts (roster, coach, Christmas, Cup, Specter reveal), since they were seeded with verified data. Three live checks held up: the Oct 21 home opener, the gold E Line and Pann's still open. Fixed: the Forum Blue history in uniform.json, Reaves's Arkansas origin and number (15), and the Specter merchandise already released Sept 9. Also fixed: the Icon/Association color labels and some shaky specifics, namely Kuya Lord in Lomita, the Born x Raised founders, Tanter and Drew League-Nike. Strategy still needs edits on Specter timing, Icon naming, Kuya Lord and stale verify items. The remaining risk is venue and store status, ownership, the statue roster and partner availability.
